फिल्म Ramayana की स्टारकास्ट को लेकर एक बहुत ही खास अपडेट सामने आया है! 🎬

फिल्म में भगवान राम की मां कौशल्या का रोल निभा रहीं एक्ट्रेस इंदिरा कृष्णन ने अपने Instagram अकाउंट पर पहली कास्ट रीडिंग सेशन की अनसीन तस्वीरें शेयर की हैं। 📸

इंदिरा ने बताया कि फिल्म Animal के बाद Ranbir Kapoor को Lord Ram के रोल में ढलते देखना अद्भुत था और उन्होंने रणबीर के ट्रांसफॉर्मेशन की जमकर तारीफ की। ✨

उन्होंने Sita का रोल कर रहीं Sai Pallavi की मासूमियत को सराहा और डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari के गाइडेंस की तारीफ करते हुए बताया कि उनका एक कठिन सीन 1 take में शूट हो गया था।

इतना ही नहीं, पोस्ट में इंदिरा ने यह भी जिक्र किया कि शूटिंग के एक बड़े सेटअप में 80 से भी ज्यादा कैमरों का इस्तेमाल किया गया था। 🎥

क्या आप Ranbir Kapoor को पर्दे पर Lord Ram के रूप में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.title: Indira Krishnan praises Ranbir Kapoor's transformation from Animal to Lord Rama in Ramayana, shares pics from first reading
ctx.summary: Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita with Yash playing the role of Ravana. The film released on November 5.
ctx.text:
With Ramayana releasing in theatres on November 5, Indira Krishnan has been looking back at some of the moments she shared with the cast during the making of the film. The actor, who plays Kaushalya, Lord Rama's mother, posted pictures from the cast's first reading session on Instagram. Along with the photographs, she wrote about her co-stars and the people she worked with, sharing her admiration for Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi and recalling her experience of working with director Nitesh Tiwari.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram and Sai Pallavi as Sita with Yash playing the role of Ravana. The film has been generating interest since its announcement, and its release has prompted Indira to revisit the early days of a project that brought the cast together long before it reached the big screen.
Indira looked back at the cast's first reading session and shared how much she admired Ranbir, both for his acting and the person he is off screen. Having seen his performance in Animal before watching him step into the role of Lord Ram, she said she was struck by his transformation. Praising him, she wrote, “Our first day of cast reading session. What a memorable day and today I could feel this nostalgia. RK I hv no words to tell how beautiful inside out u are. From Animal to Ramayana I witnessed this pure soul actor and believe me he nailed it. Take a bow RK.”
Indira had equally warm words for Sai Pallavi, praising her innocence and spiritual side. She felt their coming together for Ramayana was no coincidence, writing, “Sai ur innocence speaks volumes and ur spiritual thought has brought u to this platform ..ur right we all were destined to meet here.” She also thanked Ravi for looking after her during their stay in Chandigarh, remembering his kindness and calling him a "sweetheart".
Indira also spoke warmly about director Nitesh Tiwari, recalling a scene she had to shoot just before the Vanvas sequence. She said his guidance helped her understand the scene better and get the shot right in one take.
She also had a word of praise for her co-stars and the crew. Indira remembered Rakul Preet Singh as polite and cheerful on set, and appreciated her performance as Surpanakha. She thanked casting director Mukesh Chhabra for putting the ensemble together and acknowledged Jay Kar's work behind the camera. Recalling the scale of the shoot, she mentioned one setup that involved more than 80 cameras. Signing off with a message for the team, Indira wrote, “Love u all ..cheers to the team cheers to Namit Malhotra's Ramayana..JAI SHREE RAM.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Part 1 stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The film is produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations.
The second installment is confirmed for 2028 release. The film arrived in theatres in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam and will be screened in IMAX and other premium formats. Sony Pictures is handling international distribution outside India, while Dharma Productions is distributing the film in the Hindi-speaking market.
